libraries.label: Purdue adults, whole bodies
libraries.platform: Oxford Nanopore MinION (R9 flow cells, ligation library)
libraries.animal: wild adults from a canal in the Florida Keys (isolate ECLA1), starved for at least two weeks; DNA from whole bodies, used for the Purdue assembly
libraries.note: All eleven runs, from five flow cells, analysed in full and aligned to the Purdue assembly. The archive record refers to adults in the plural and does not state how many animals contributed DNA.

libraries.label: Purdue adults, brains
libraries.platform: Oxford Nanopore MinION (R9 flow cell, ligation library)
libraries.animal: brains dissected from wild adults of the same isolate (ECLA1)
libraries.note: The single run, analysed in full and aligned to the Purdue assembly.

libraries.label: Purdue egg mass
libraries.animal: an egg mass of the same isolate (ECLA1), collected within 24 hours of deposition: germline DNA, which contains no ingested algal material
libraries.note: The complete library, aligned to the Purdue assembly.

libraries.label: Tampa long-read library
libraries.animal: an animal collected at Pickles Reef, Key Largo, Florida, and sequenced at the University of Tampa; library EC2, made by whole-genome amplification
libraries.note: The complete run, aligned to the Tampa assembly.

libraries.label: Tampa short-read library
libraries.animal: a second animal, registered in the archive under the same sample record as the long-read library; library EC1
libraries.note: The complete library, aligned to the Tampa assembly.
